title: Need to fiddle with unintuitive settings to be able to connect to two Ethernet networks at the same time
line: Connecting a wired network on a second Ethernet card no longer disconnects the first card.
explanation: A wired profile that isn't restricted to a device (the usual case for profiles made by hand or by installers) is listed in the Networks popup once per wired card. NetworkManager activates a profile on only one device at a time by default, so clicking Connect on the second card's row moved the profile there and disconnected the first card; the only way around it was setting "Restrict to device" in the connection editor. Now, when such a wired profile is already active on another card, the applet first sets the profile's multi-connect to "manual-multiple" (keeping every other setting as NetworkManager returned it) and then activates it, so both cards stay connected.

commits.message:
libs/handler: keep the first wired card connected when connecting a second

A wired profile that isn't restricted to a device is listed for every
wired card, but connecting it on a second card took the first one down.
Let such a profile be activated on several devices when this happens.

BUG: 478207

media.caption: One wired profile, two Ethernet cards: connected on enp3s0, Connect offered for enp0s20u1
After clicking Connect on enp0s20u1: enp3s0 was disconnected (the rows just swap)
Same starting state with the fix
After clicking Connect on enp0s20u1: both cards connected
